DayTask.title: DayTask
DayTask.description: A time-blocked daily task or activity tile scheduled on a specific date.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this task.

dateKey.description: ISO date key in YYYY-MM-DD format representing the day of the task.

title.description: Short title of the task or activity block.

notes.description: Optional details or reflection notes for the task.

startMinute.description: Start time in minutes from midnight (0 to 1439).

durationMinutes.description: Duration of the task block in minutes (15 to 720).

category.description: Activity category for visual tile styling.

colorIndex.description: Palette index (0 to 5) for the tile accent color.

reminderMinutes.description: Minutes before start time to trigger a notification reminder (-1 for none).

completed.description: Whether the task tile has been completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was created (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was last updated (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DayJournal.title: DayJournal
DayJournal.description: Daily journal reflection, intention headline, and mood rating for a specific date.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this journal entry.

dateKey.description: ISO date key in YYYY-MM-DD format matching the document ID.

headline.description: Daily highlight or focus intention headline.

content.description: Freeform daily journal and reflection text.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the journal entry was created (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the journal entry was last updated (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Per-user collection of daily timeline task tiles.

/users/{userId}/journals/{dateKey}.description: Per-user collection of daily journal entries keyed by YYYY-MM-DD date string.
